channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Fireworks explosion at Mexico patron saint festival kills 10
item.description: A deadly blast at a Mexican patron saint festival echoes a long, unresolved tension between sacred tradition and the stubborn risks of artisanal pyrotechnics.

item.title: Mexico remittances fall amid US crackdown as fintech apps boom
item.description: Mexico's remittance income dropped to $61.79 billion in 2025, snapping an 11-year growth streak, while fintech apps gain ground under a new US tax.

item.title: Mateo Messi captains Inter Miami Academy to Naples Cup title
item.description: The 10-year-old scored five goals to spark a comeback from 1-4 down, lifting the U10 trophy at Paradise Coast Sports Complex.

item.title: Middle East war drives oil near $90, raising fuel costs in Argentina
item.description: Brent crude climbed from $62 to $90 a barrel since January, pushing gasoline up 27% and diesel up 23% at Argentine pumps.

item.title: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt state election, falls short of majority
item.description: The AfD secured 43.8% of the vote in Saxony-Anhalt on Sunday, winning 39 of 83 parliament seats but falling short of a governing majority.

item.title: Cruz Azul hosts Club América in Liga MX Apertura 2026 Clásico Joven
item.description: Club América rolls into Estadio Banorte on Saturday riding a perfect 5-0-1 mark, while Cruz Azul looks to even up a rivalry América still leads.

item.title: Argentina grain prices hit decade high as exports set record
item.description: Wheat hits USD 237.5 per tonne and total exports are on track to smash USD 103 billion, a national record.

item.title: US restricts government travel to Nogales, Mexico over unspecified threat
item.description: The U.S. Mission to Mexico has limited government personnel travel in Nogales, Sonora, to essential daytime movement, citing unspecified threat information.

item.title: Federal court revives expedited removals as Trump expands deportation reach
item.description: A federal appeals court cleared the way for nationwide expedited removals as the administration accelerates deportations of migrant children and expands third-country flight programs.

item.title: Toluca wins Leagues Cup 2026, first Liga MX title since 2021
item.description: Los Diablos Rojos shut out Monterrey 2-0 in Houston to claim the Leagues Cup and end Liga MX's five-year drought in the competition.

item.title: Amazon cargo plane overruns Miami runway, killing five
item.description: Prime Air Flight 7598 overran a runway at Miami International Airport Sunday afternoon, killing five people and injuring five others.

item.title: US fuel prices hit Labor Day record as Iran war crimps supply
item.description: AAA says regular gasoline averaged $4.14 a gallon heading into Labor Day 2026, topping the prior record as the Iran conflict continues to disrupt global oil supply.

item.title: Iran claims strike on US vessel in Strait of Hormuz; US denies it
item.description: Iran claimed Sunday it struck a U.S. unmanned vessel in the Strait of Hormuz; the U.S. military called the assertion a 'total lie.'

item.title: 2026 midterms enter final stretch with Congress control at stake
item.description: With Republicans holding a narrow House majority and Senate control in play, both parties are framing November 3 as a defining referendum on the Trump administration.

item.title: Aguirre backs Márquez to lead Mexico after World Cup exit
item.description: Aguirre endorsed Márquez as Mexico's next coach at a Fundación Telmex Telcel event days after El Tri's World Cup exit.

item.title: Tigres and Necaxa draw 1-1 in Liga MX Apertura 2026
item.description: Nahuel Guzmán's penalty save kept Tigres alive, but Vucetich's side stays 14th after dropping two points at home.

item.title: ICE arrests surge as majority of detainees lack criminal records
item.description: Federal arrest data contradicts administration claims as ICE sets consecutive monthly records exceeding 50,000 arrests.

item.title: Oil States Brasil wins Petrobras subsea maintenance contract
item.description: The Macaé-based firm locks in a three-year Petrobras deal covering inspection, maintenance and intervention for a wide range of subsea equipment.

item.title: Wright says Iran nuclear deal may not happen under current regime
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Sunday a nuclear agreement with Iran may not be reachable under its current government, while U.S. forces struck Iranian oil carriers.

item.title: Atlante draws 1-1 at Atlas in Liga MX Jornada 7
item.description: Atlante rescue a point in Guadalajara but remain 14th, while Atlas stay fourth after failing to hold an early lead.

item.title: Armed assailant lunges at Ohio governor candidate Acton at fair
item.description: A suspect carrying multiple weapons was arrested after lunging at Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton at the Canfield Fair in Ohio on Sunday.

item.title: Raúl Castro, 95, appears at Cuban military anniversary ceremony
item.description: The 95-year-old former Cuban president appeared in uniform at a Havana ceremony marking the 65th anniversary of the Personal Security Directorate.

item.title: GOP lawmakers break with Trump on Iran war, Putin approach
item.description: Two Republican lawmakers publicly broke with President Trump Sunday over his characterization of the Iran conflict and his administration's approach to Russia.

item.title: Cruz Azul hosts Santos Laguna in Liga MX Apertura 2026
item.description: Cruz Azul host winless Santos Laguna on Sunday night in a Liga MX Apertura 2026 clash that could push either club in opposite directions.

item.title: Trump posts Truth Social map suggesting New Mexico become 'New America'
item.description: A Sunday Truth Social post renaming New Mexico 'New America' fits a pattern worth examining carefully, whatever its ultimate policy weight.

item.title: Argentina's trade opening reshapes industry: winners and losers in 2026
item.description: Record imports, 97,000 lost factory jobs, and machines sitting idle: Argentina's trade opening is reshaping who wins and who survives.

item.title: Filipe Luis vows to keep pursuing Cruz Azul midfielder Erik Lira
item.description: Monaco's Filipe Luis says he will chase Cruz Azul captain Erik Lira every transfer window after a last-minute roster snag killed the summer deal.

item.title: Kany García brings 'Puerta Abierta' tour to the United States
item.description: The seven-time Latin Grammy winner brings her biggest tour yet stateside, opening September 7 in California and wrapping October 4 in Orlando.

item.title: Infantino confirms re-election bid despite World Cup sell-off backlash
item.description: Infantino will seek a fourth FIFA term in March 2027 despite a failed $20 billion tournament sell-off that cost him the support of three major confederations.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner visit Kyiv for first time in peace push
item.description: The Witkoff-Kushner shuttle between Moscow and Kyiv revives a diplomatic architecture not seen since the war's earliest days.

item.title: El-Sayed's past remarks and associations draw scrutiny in Michigan Senate race
item.description: Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed faces questions over DSA appearances, past remarks on upward mobility, and his association with controversial public figures.

item.title: Former Air Force secretary and new poll raise doubts over Iran war
item.description: A former Air Force secretary questioned the advice Trump received before entering the conflict, as a new poll shows softening Republican support.

item.title: ICE issues court notices to migrants not fully processed amid CBP Home probe
item.description: ICE is filing court notices for roughly 445,000 migrants released without full processing, as the administration's CBP Home app pushes voluntary departures.

item.title: Argentina marks 1,000 days of Milei with mixed economic results
item.description: Inflation crashed, poverty fell, and country risk dropped sharply—but unemployment climbed and formal jobs shrank over Milei's first 1,000 days.

item.title: Missouri asks U.S. Supreme Court to restore blocked redistricting map
item.description: Missouri's redistricting clash at the Supreme Court echoes a long national argument about who ultimately draws the lines of political power.

item.title: Mexico eyes Arizona semiconductor role as USMCA review stalls
item.description: Ebrard signs ASU deal and meets chip giants in Phoenix as USMCA talks drag past deadline with no automotive deal in sight.

item.title: USMCA talks collapse raises stakes for US-Mexico trade
item.description: US-Canada USMCA talks collapsed in August 2026, triggering 50% tariffs and raising pressure on Mexico negotiations that could reshape North American trade.

item.title: Inter Miami draws 2-2 with Atlanta after weather delay, Hoyos blasts referees
item.description: A 95-minute weather delay and a late Atlanta penalty denied Inter Miami a home win, sending interim coach Guillermo Hoyos into a post-match tirade against officials.

item.title: Inter Miami draw 2-2 with Atlanta United in weather-delayed match
item.description: A late Breel Embolo penalty denied Inter Miami all three points Saturday, leaving the Herons at 12-6-5 on the season.

item.title: AfD votes in Saxony-Anhalt election seeking first far-right state government
item.description: Voters in Saxony-Anhalt cast ballots Sunday in a race that could produce Germany's first far-right state government since World War II.
